currentParagraphText: “Funny, I’m over here not even thinking I’ll get a level-up by killing you,” Jake answered casually as he began walking forward without any weapons drawn. “But you should also be proud. Dying to me in a duel will give your Records and Path far more meaning than you can even imagine. Perhaps I’ll even remember this encounter... assuming you make it memorable enough.”
